- 12:30 PM: Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. Duration: 1.5 hours. Cost: Included in Colosseum ticket.
- 02:30 PM: Lunch near Monti district. Budget: 20 Euro.
- 04:30 PM: Walk to Pantheon. Duration: 45 mins. Cost: Free (Reservation required).
- 07:30 PM: Dinner near Pantheon. Budget: 35 Euro.
- Daily Total: 73 Euro.

- 02:00 PM: Lunch near Prati. Budget: 20 Euro.
- 04:00 PM: Walk along the Tiber to Trastevere. Cost: Free.
- 07:00 PM: Dinner in Trastevere. Budget: 35 Euro.

components.text: The Herman Miller Aeron is a classic mesh task chair focused on suspended support, while the Steelcase Gesture is designed for modern tech users, supporting a wide range of postures and device-usage styles.
- Aeron (Size B): Features the PostureFit SL system. It uses two adjustable pads that stabilize the sacrum and support the lumbar region of the spine to mimic a standing posture.
- Gesture: Features "3D LiveBack" technology. The backrest automatically contours to mimic the natural movement of the spine, providing continuous support as you change positions.
- Aeron (Size B): 3D Armrests. They adjust for height, depth (sliding forward/backward), and pivot (turning inward/outward). They are attached to the seat back.
- Gesture: 4D Armrests. Known for the best range in the industry, they adjust for height, width, depth, and 360-degree pivot. They are designed to support users holding mobile devices or tablets.
- Aeron (Size B): Standard model includes a Tilt Limiter with three settings (upright, mid-recline, full recline) and a Seat Angle adjustment (Forward Tilt) for engaged tasks.

- Gesture: Features a variable back stop with four positions. It lacks the forward tilt option found on the Aeron but offers a more seamless "synchro-tilt" that keeps feet flat on the floor while reclining.

components.text: Garmin Venu 2 is a fitness-first watch with deep physiological data, while the Apple Watch Series 8 is a general-purpose smartwatch with advanced medical-grade health sensors.

- Garmin Venu 2: Samples heart rate continuously (every second), both at rest and during exercise. This provides a very high-resolution view of heart rate changes.
- Apple Watch Series 8: During rest, it samples every few minutes to save battery. During exercise, it switches to continuous (every second) sampling.

components.text: Pruning Shears Guide for Seattle Rose Gardens
These work like scissors, where two sharp blades pass by each other. This creates a clean, precise cut.
These have one sharp blade that closes down onto a flat metal or plastic plate (the anvil). This works like a knife on a chopping board.

Reason: Roses have live green tissue that needs to heal quickly to prevent disease (common in damp Seattle climates). Bypass shears provide a clean slice that leaves the plant's vascular system intact.
Why Anvil Shears Damage Live Tissue

Anvil shears use a crushing motion to complete the cut. On live green stems, this crushing action bruises the delicate cambium layer and mashes the stem fibers. This creates a ragged wound that is slow to heal and serves as an entry point for fungi and pests. Anvil shears should only be used for dead, brittle wood where the crushing doesn't matter.
- Prune in late February or early March when the forsythia blooms.
- Always cut at a 45-degree angle, 1/4 inch above an outward-facing bud.
- Clean your blades with isopropyl alcohol between plants to prevent the spread of Black Spot or Mildew.
